title: Silver Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - 0% APR for the First Year
summary: This document explains the Silver Rewards Card new customer promo: new accounts opened between 2025-10-15 and 2025-12-31 get 0% APR on carried balances for the first year, then the APR becomes 18.99%. You must pay at least the statement minimum monthly during the promo to stay in good standing.
